scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Haryana to provide financial assistance and social security to workers in the unorganized sector. 

This scheme was officially launched on 1st July 2021. 

The primary objective of the Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is to ensure the welfare and safety of laborers working in various unorganized sectors. 

The scheme aims to provide financial support in the form of insurance coverage and assistance during emergencies. 

One of the measurable targets of this scheme is to cover approximately 1.5 million laborers in the state of Haryana. 

The scheme also aims to provide immediate financial assistance to the families of workers who face accidental deaths or disabilities. 

Under this scheme, beneficiaries are entitled to receive a sum of INR 2 lakh in case of accidental death. 

In the event of permanent disability due to an accident, beneficiaries can receive up to INR 2 lakh as well. 

For partial disability, the amount of assistance is INR 1 lakh. 

Additionally, the scheme provides a monthly financial assistance of INR 3,000 to beneficiaries who are unable to work due to health issues. 

The eligibility criteria for the Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana include workers aged between 18 and 60 years. 

Applicants must be residents of Haryana and must belong to the unorganized sector. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at INR 15,000 per month. 

Workers must not be enrolled in any other government social security scheme to qualify for this assistance. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Interested applicants must visit the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

They need to fill out the application form available on the website. 

The required documents include a valid identity proof such as an Aadhar card, proof of residence, and income certificate. 

Applicants must also provide a passport-sized photograph and any relevant documents that prove their employment in the unorganized sector. 

After filling out the application form, applicants must submit it along with the required documents. 

Once submitted, the application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The timeline for processing applications typically ranges from 15 to 30 days. 

Beneficiaries can expect to receive the financial assistance within a month after their application is approved. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

This ensures transparency and efficiency in the distribution of funds. 

The implementing authority for the Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The board is responsible for overseeing the implementation of the scheme and ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The contact details for the Haryana Labour Welfare Board can be found on their official website. 

The board also conducts awareness programs to educate workers about the benefits of the scheme. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has successfully registered over 500,000 beneficiaries. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the successful implementation of this scheme. 

The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to improve the living conditions of laborers. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the financial burden on families of workers who face unforeseen circumstances. 

The government has emphasized the importance of providing social security to unorganized sector workers. 

This initiative is aligned with the national goal of ensuring social protection for all workers in India. 

The scheme is expected to create a safety net for workers who often lack access to traditional forms of social security. 

By providing financial assistance, the government aims to enhance the overall welfare of laborers in Haryana. 

The scheme is also expected to encourage more workers to register themselves and avail benefits. 

The Haryana government has been proactive in addressing the needs of the labor force through various schemes. 

The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is a testament to this commitment. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have experienced its benefits firsthand. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Regular assessments are conducted to identify areas for improvement. 

The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is a crucial step towards ensuring the welfare of laborers in Haryana. 

It reflects the government's dedication to providing a safety net for vulnerable populations. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also promotes awareness about workers' rights. 

Through this initiative, the Haryana government aims to empower laborers and improve their quality of life. 

The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is an essential component of Haryana's labor welfare policies. 

It underscores the importance of social security in fostering economic stability for workers. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over time to meet the changing needs of the labor force. 

The Haryana government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of its workers through innovative schemes. 

This initiative is a significant milestone in the journey towards comprehensive labor welfare in the state. 

The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana serves as a model for other states to follow in providing social security to unorganized workers. 

Overall, this scheme represents a proactive approach to labor welfare in Haryana. 

It aims to create a more secure and supportive environment for all workers in the unorganized sector. 

The Mukhya Mantri Sharmik Surksha Yojana is a vital step towards achieving equitable growth and development in the state.
